About this item

  • Music matters: Fire up the music player and enjoy your favourite tunes around the clock with the powerful built-in loudspeaker. Plus, you can tune into FM Radio with or without a headset.
  • Talk for longer: Talk from sunrise ‘til sundown1 and fill your day with good conversations. The 1450mAh battery delivers hours of talk time, or up to a month of standby.
  • Ease of use: Big 2.4” display, tactile keymat, balanced design and easy-to-use UI make navigating, the features or texting simple and fast.
  • Built to last: Each Nokia phone go through rigorous durability tests so you can trust your device to deliver even if the day gets more hectic.

    How are ratings calculated?
    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find the phone's quality good and appreciate its appearance, with one noting its elegant feel. However, the functionality receives negative feedback, with multiple customers reporting issues like the microphone stopping working and the device becoming unusable after 30 days of use. The battery life is poor, lasting only 12 hours, and the Bluetooth connectivity is missing. Moreover, the voice quality and build quality receive mixed reviews, with some praising the clear sound while others report low volume on both sides, and some noting manufacturing defects on the keypad. Value for money is also mixed, with some finding it good while others consider it overpriced.

      Reviewed in India on 14 January 2026

      This phone is a durable and reliable choice, especially considering its price point. After using it for several months, I’ve found that the build quality is excellent; it has survived multiple accidental drops without any damage to the hardware.

      The camera quality is good for the price, though it naturally doesn't compete with high-end smartphones.

      One important note for potential buyers: this phone uses a standard (large) SIM slot, not a nano-SIM slot. If you try to use a nano-SIM without an adapter, it will likely get misplaced inside the device and cause connection disruptions. Make sure to keep the SIM slot intact and use the correct size for a stable connection.

      Pros:

      Highly durable and impact-resistant build.

      Decent camera performance for its budget category.

      Reliable long-term performance over several months.

      Cons:

      The large SIM slot is incompatible with nano-SIMs unless you use an adapter kit.

      Don't let the brand name fool you. For ₹2,600, this phone is a disaster. The software is buggy, frustrating, and completely unfit for a feature phone.

      Complicated UI: Even checking missed or received calls is a nightmare. You have to dig through multiple menus and settings just to see basic call history.

      Not Senior-Friendly: It is far too complex for elderly users. What should be simple is made unnecessarily difficult.

      Verdict: It’s an annoying, buggy device that fails at the basics. Save your money and avoid this model.

    About this Item

    • Music matters: Fire up the music player and enjoy your favourite tunes around the clock with the powerful built-in loudspeaker. Plus, you can tune into FM Radio with or without a headset.
    • Talk for longer: Talk from sunrise ‘til sundown1 and fill your day with good conversations. The 1450mAh battery delivers hours of talk time, or up to a month of standby.
    • Ease of use: Big 2.4” display, tactile keymat, balanced design and easy-to-use UI make navigating, the features or texting simple and fast.
    • Built to last: Each Nokia phone go through rigorous durability tests so you can trust your device to deliver even if the day gets more hectic.

    Product description

    From the moment you wake up to when you turn in at night, fill your day with music and conversations. With its big battery and powerful speaker, Nokia 150 lasts long and plays loud. Use the dedicated Music key to jump straight into your favorite tracks and play them around the clock.
